title: Midweek KPI Sharpener — personal check-in
body:
Purpose: quick midweek scratch to recalibrate my personal objectives and small experiments that influence team KPIs. Not a formal retro — lightweight notes to avoid derailment and catch small wins/losses before end of week.

Snapshot (Wed AM):
- Energy: 6/10 (slept poorly, coffee + walk helps)
- Focus windows available: 2 x 90m today, 1 x 60m tomorrow
- Top commitment this sprint: reduce 95th-pct latency for small-chat endpoint by 12%

Leading indicators I'm watching (non-goal metrics that predict progress):
1) Percent of L7 requests benefiting from prefix cache hit (target this sprint: +8pp). Current: 21% -> goal 29%
2) Dev loop time on repro of latency regression (target < 30m). Current median: 48m -> blocker: infra snapshot not reproducible locally
3) Test coverage on critical decoder path (add 2 unit tests this week).

Concrete micro-tasks (today/this week)
- Quick: write one focused unit test for edge-case KVC eviction (30m)
- Medium: prototype change to batching threshold heuristic (2-3h)
- Medium: add debug flag + small perf trace in staging for 95th-pct experiment (1h)
- Long: pair with SRE on infra snapshot reproducibility (60-90m pairing)

Hypotheses to validate (ranked by expected ROI)
A) Small increase in early prefix cache hits yields disproportionate reduction in tail latency for chat-reqs. (If true -> prioritize caching heuristics)
B) Current batching threshold tuned to median throughput, not bursty tails; adapt threshold by observed short-term qps to reduce tail latency. (If true -> implement adaptive threshold)

Quick experiments & expected signal
- Experiment 1: add 50ms delay window to allow additional micro-batching for requests from same session (signal: drop in 95th by >=4%). Risk: increased median latency by ~1-3ms.
- Experiment 2: conservative cache pre-eviction for tiny prompts to preserve KV for longer sessions (signal: cache-hit rate +6pp). Risk: memory pressure -> monitor GPU memory and OOMs.

Blockers / mitigations
- Blocker: cannot reproduce production tail locally. Mitigation: collect lightweight prod trace (approved), add debug flag to sampling at 0.2% traffic. Pair with SRE tomorrow.
- Blocker: limited time this sprint due to onboarding 2 interns. Mitigation: delegate one troubleshooting task to intern, define clear acceptance criteria and quick feedback loop.

Weekly retrospective mini-notes (what I learned so far this sprint)
- Small, targeted tests (unit-level + focused perf traces) are higher leverage than wide refactors at this point.
- Documenting reproducible steps saves ~30-45m per future incident; invest the 1h now.

Personal discipline checkpoints (end of week quick audit)
- Did I ship at least one measurable change toward the top commitment? (Y/N)
- Did I unblock others this week by documenting reproducer or adding a debug flag? (Y/N)
- Did I delegate at least one time-consuming task and review it within 48h? (Y/N)

Notes to self for tomorrow
- Before pairing: draft a 5-bullet runbook to reproduce the tail locally (helps focus pairing)
- When adding trace: ensure sampling header uses trace-id for correlating logs across services
- Quick shout: update the sprint board with two new tasks (proto-batching + cache test) and tag Samir for review.

Open questions (short list):
- What is acceptable median+tail tradeoff for small-chat customers? (Need product signoff)
- Is there a low-risk rollout path (canary % + automatic rollback) we can use for the micro-batching test? (Ask @Product-hosted-api)

End-of-note checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] Add unit test for KVC eviction
- [ ] Implement debug trace flag in staging
- [ ] Pair with SRE and collect sampled prod traces
- [ ] Create two tasks on sprint board and assign
